title: Size-exclusion polishing on Superdex 200, concentration and flash-freezing
summary: Final polishing of a purified protein by gel filtration on Superdex 200, followed by ultrafiltration to about 3 mg/mL and flash-freezing in liquid nitrogen. Source is the same crystallography paper as the IMAC protocol.

steps.text: Equilibrate a Superdex 200 column in 20 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 500 mM NaCl, 0.5 mM TCEP.
Inject the post-reverse-IMAC protein and collect the monodisperse peak fractions.
Pool clean fractions (judge by SDS-PAGE) and concentrate in a 10 kDa cut-off Amicon Ultra device to about 3 mg/mL.

duration_s.note: Spin time depends on volume; 30 min assumed.

steps.text: Flash-freeze aliquots in liquid nitrogen and keep at -80 C until crystallisation.

safety: Liquid nitrogen: cryo gloves, face shield, never seal a closed vessel.
TCEP is an irritant; wear gloves.
notes: Source reports yield of about 1.5 mg per litre of culture. Column dimensions, flow rate and injection volume are not given, so no run time is recorded.
